message: The other day, I was chatting with my neighbor about smoke alarms. I casually mentioned how I finally got around to changing the batteries in mine—and wouldn’t you know it, a few days later, hers started beeping like a confused bird! 😅 I couldn’t help but feel a tiny bit smug, but really, it was a good reminder to check those things regularly. We all get busy, but a little upkeep can go a long way in keeping our homes safe. It’s funny how the simplest tasks can save us from a lot of hassle later, right?
